authority: ../src/hooks/sequences.js and ../src/hooks/motion.js are the authoritative motion sources for this project. CLONE_SPEC.md sections 2.2, 3.4, 4.2, 4.4, 4.5 and 4.6 were superseded by two independent re-measurement passes against the live original; see extraction/measured-values.json#supersededClaims.

intersection-threshold-0.note: Every real trigger observer on the page is a bare {threshold: 0} with NO rootMargin. Nothing is ever re-armed and no `-active` class is ever removed, so armed cascades are one-shot and keep their own clock after arming.
intersection-threshold-0.supersedes: CLONE_SPEC 3.4's rootMargin:'200px' and 2.2's '0px 0px -100px 0px' are both wrong; CLONE_SPEC 3.4's 'clear the interval on exit' is not real behaviour.

mount.note: Two timelines are NOT intersection-gated and run from page load: the RBAC card's clock and the complete section's user-progress rows. Verified by parking the original at scrollY 407 with both blocks far below the fold and observing inline writes already in flight.

scroll-scrub.note: Two systems are genuinely scroll-scrubbed. A performance-only IntersectionObserver with rootMargin '800px 0px 800px 0px' gates the rAF loop; it is NOT the trigger — the trigger is the clamp inside the progress function.
scroll-scrub.supersedes: CLONE_SPEC 3.4's 'no scroll-linked (scrubbed) animation anywhere' is wrong.

paint-time-intro.note: The hero's intro is a paint-time state in the original's server HTML (`.hero--intro`), not a transition from a previous state. The clone adds the class on the next frame, which is one frame later by necessity; the END states match.

user-input.note: Click only. Two widgets site-wide (hero light switch, 12-button customiser).

lerp.default.note: Fitted from the geometric tail of the settle (ratio ~0.625 per ~6 frames). The TARGETS it damps toward are exact.

keyframes.rule: All 29 @keyframes blocks live in src/index.css and nowhere else. No section stylesheet declares one. Verified: grep -c '^@keyframes' returns 29 for src/index.css and 0 for every src/styles/*.css.
keyframes.note: `line-anim` exists twice in the original stylesheet under two CSS-module scopes; the clone keeps them as `line-anim` and `card-line-anim`.

reducedMotion.cloneBehaviour: The clone adds a global guard clamping animation-duration and transition-duration to 0.01ms with iteration-count 1, AND every JS loop checks prefersReducedMotion() itself. This is a deliberate accessibility improvement over the original, not a fidelity defect.

particleFields.note: Four canvases, read off the original's own instrumented draw calls (ctx.clearRect / ctx.arc / ctx.fillStyle patched on the live site). CLONE_SPEC 4.1 marked these approximate; they are now measured.

starfield.note: Height-normalised, so every starfield crosses its own canvas in the same time. x NEVER changes.

dotField.note: Width-normalised. The only field that moves horizontally; y NEVER changes.

alpha.note: A RAW sine, not an absolute value. Negative alphas are passed straight to rgba() (the original really does emit rgba(255,255,255,-0.48...)) and clamp to invisible, so ~48% of particles are mathematically invisible at any instant.

fill.note: White is the ONLY fill colour any of the four canvases ever uses.

twinklePhaseStep.unit: rad/frame (upper bound of a uniform distribution)
twinklePhaseStep.method: Derived analytically: cos(s) = (a0 + a2) / (2*a1) from three consecutive frames at full float precision over 724 particles; three independent estimators read 0.0653 / 0.0611 / 0.0623.

sizing.rule: All four canvases are lazily sized to their LAYOUT box (offsetWidth/offsetHeight) on first intersection, with no devicePixelRatio scaling. Using getBoundingClientRect() is wrong: `.security-rbac__dots` carries transform:scale(0.5), so the client rect reads 64x182 while the real backing store is 128x363.
